messages:
erin: Hey all — planning to flip the feature toggle `new_batch_cache_v2` in prod tomorrow at 10:00 PST. Scope: ~8% traffic, only us-west, exclude heavy accounts. Need quick preflight sign-off + canary watchers. I'll include perf checks and rollback steps below.

josh: :eyes: Does this include the LRU cap change? worried about mem spikes if multiple shards bump.

erin: Yes — includes the LRU cap to 2GB/shard and the prefetched-KV backoff. Key metrics to watch: p95 latency, token/s on GPU, redis hitrate, 5xx rate. I'll add the dashboard link in a sec.

sophie: Add me as a canary watcher. What's the exact flag id + kill-switch command? I can be on-call during the window.

erin: Flag id: `ff::batch_cache_v2.enabled`. Rollback (ops CLI): `redwood ff set --env prod --flag batch_cache_v2.enabled false --scope all` — also in the runbook.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by erin for 2026-03-18T18:00Z. Canary target: 8% traffic in us-west. Auto-escalate if p95 increases > 20% or 5xx spikes.

josh: Quick perf preflight ask: someone run the locust script against staging with seq_len=512 and batch_size=16. My command: `python tests/load_locust.py --target staging --seq 512 --iters 5`

kelly: I'll run that now, will report numbers.

kelly: Results (staging, warmed KV): p95 svc latency 112ms -> 128ms (+14%), redis hitrate 41% -> 70%, no increase in 5xx during runs. CPU/GPU util stable. Will rerun with cold cache too.

sophie: :thumbsup: Looks acceptable. Suggested guardrails: auto-kill if p95 delta > 25% OR 5xx > 0.3%. Agree?

erin: Agree on guardrails. Let's codify: relative p95 > 20% OR absolute p95 > 150ms (whichever tripped), 5xx > 0.3% -> immediate rollback. Also enable verbose canary logs for first 30m.

josh: Also ensure canary audience excludes long-tailed/high-qps customers: audience rule `user_id % 100 < 8` AND exclude top_qps_accounts list.

erin: Good call — I'll update the flag audience to that and attach the exclusion list. Also enabling `DEBUG_CANARY=1` env for extra traces.

oncall-bot: Reminder: if auto-escalation fires, page `oncall@redwood` and follow runbook: https://redwood.dev/runbooks/cache-batch-rollout

sophie: I can cover 17:50-19:00 PST and watch the dashboards + traces.

kelly: Rollback notes: after flipping flag false, run `redwood infra scale --pool batch-v2 0` to drain new instances and clear warm KV. Also clear per-host caches if needed.

erin: Thanks everyone. I'll post a final checklist + link to the dashboards in ~2 hours and set the scheduled job. :rocket:
